rows.ARS:
Pink blend Shrub.
Registration name: MEIsecaso
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1980).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie in 1983 as 'Lutin'.
Introduced in Australia by Ross Roses in 1989 as 'Shady Lady'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, white undertones, fuchsia / magenta shading. (Rose de Bengale). up to 15 petals. Average diameter 2.75". Medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, upright. Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 47" (90 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Shade tolerant. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
MEIsecaso is referred to as the parentage for Pearl Meidiland.
Mandy, in Western Australia, is growing Shady Lady and says that it is hot pink, flat and double, with a yellow center. It is almost thornless and tolerates shade.
Melville Nurseries says Shady Lady has clusters of rose-pink blooms with creamy white centres...

colour: Pink, white undertones, fuchsia / magenta shading. (Rose de Bengale).
